correctness.rationale: Alternating zero/one cyclic runs t with singleton counts u0,u1 yield c1=2t-2u0+u1 and c2=2t+u0-2u1, hence A=(2c1+c2)/3 and B=(c1+2c2)/3. Choose t=ceil(max(A,B)/2) satisfying t<=min(A,B), with strict inequalities when c0,c3 positive, then allocate length1/length2 runs and extras to construct each profile. Count interior/boundary congruence cells to get rational GF and three mod3 cubic formulas. Independent brute force words n=3..14 and collapsing full-trigram vectors reproduced the exact spectrum and counts; full-length proof is constructive, finite census alone not enough.
